rejected_boundaries: Do not convert the disjunctive action-evidence requirement into an invented current action, stable personality or a particular habit.

uncertainties.detail: Definition gives a bounded reveal-to-baseline rule but names no actor, selected state or reveal condition. No particular character contrast, morphology or event phase can be positively qualified without filling those source facts.

rejected_boundaries: Do not claim an observed repeat, invent a current task or convert one material state into demonstrated habitual personality.

uncertainties.detail: The definition alternates a task action and a material trace and requires across-scene continuity, but supplies no concrete action/trace owner or witnesses. Do not invent a current action or certify one-still habit continuity. Relationship mechanism remains pending source qualification.

uncertainties.detail: Mutual gaze resolves into a shared target OR resumed task, but no selected one-frame instant or native realization branch is supplied. Current eye contact, gaze target and resumed action cannot be unioned or invented; specify the actual positive endpoint before qualifying those roles.

rejected_boundaries: Do not invent anatomy, an SD body, a silhouette ratio, a transformation stage or a specific identity cue from family metadata.

uncertainties.detail: The compact rounded contour has no positive carrier ownership or body-versus-artifact distinction. A creature topic/provenance label is not positive anatomical evidence. Keep the actual relationship mechanism pending owned-source qualification.
